children: United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund reported a net loss of $1,175,403 for July, lowering NAV to $16,160,523 with NAV per share $5.99.
Monthly account statement for July 31, 2026 furnished under Rule 4.22; published on the fund's website.
Realized trading loss on commodity futures of $404,290 and unrealized market loss of $790,651.
Total income (loss) for July was $(1,145,173); after $30,230 expenses, net loss was $1,175,403.
NAV fell from $17,335,926 at July 1 to $16,160,523 at July 31; NAV per share (2,700,000 shares) $5.99.
